reason: I run three-plus AI agents a day and losing context between tools is genuinely annoying, but we already pay for GitHub Copilot Enterprise and I'm not adding another $30-per-seat monthly bill for an unproven local daemon from an unknown founder. The first five humans are free, so I'd kick the tires on launch day — try, not buy.
objection: We already pay for Copilot Enterprise; another agent-context subscription isn't worth a new recurring charge on an unproven tool.
would_change_my_mind: A teammate using it daily for a month and confirming the shared-context benefit is real.
